_about: Realtime Database rules for the ONE Envirothon project (ENVSITE, 2026-10-28). The DEFAULT instance holds the roster, logins, releases, scores, teacher cards and boards; each family's study lives in its OWN instance (<projectId>-<familyId>, rules in `family` below). Merge of envirothon/MIRROR_SETUP.md §2 (what the Howe mirror writes: students/<sid>/summary + meta, release read-back, release/locked) and DESIGN_envirothon_console_2026-10-27.md §2.2 as re-cut by its DECISIONS block (logins/<uid> instead of the claim; the teacher creates logins; she edits/retires her own cards; boards; who drills). 2026-10-28: release/<cid>/final/{all/<station>, students/<sid>/<station>} = {date, ts, by} — the teacher's "Open the final" (write = the release/<cid> rule; final validates the shape and that by is the writer). 2026-10-28 ⚙️ CLASS SETTINGS (ENVCLASSSET): classes/<cid>/settings/{study,drill}/<name> (the class's values; written under the classes/$cid rule — a value for a setting Adrienne locked fails .validate) · students/<sid>/settings/{study,drill}/<name> (one student's overrides; the class's teacher or admin, and the teacher never for a locked name — set or clear) · settings/locks/<name> = true (admin only; any login reads it). 2026-10-28 🏫 THE CLASS RECORD (CPCLASS, DESIGN_class_platform_2026-10-28.md §3, §9): classes/<cid> is written PER CHILD — the class's teacher may write title, emoji, color (all three refused while classes/<cid>/locks/brand is true), season, start, goals, goal, calendar, labels, features, students, teams and settings, each with its shape checked; name, teacher, lockAt and locks stay admin only (admin keeps the write on the whole class, e.g. + Class). 2026-10-29 🧠 THE DAILY-DRILL WATCH (CPWATCH, DESIGN_class_platform_2026-10-28.md §7(a) 4, §9): students/<sid>/reviewQuiet = {until:'YYYYMMDD', by} — the teacher's Leave it on the ⚠ (the class's teacher or admin; by = the writer; removing it is the Undo). summary.review rides in summary (the family's write, as before); the reminder numbers are classes/<cid>/settings/study/{remindAfterDays, warnAfterDays, warnAfterCards} under the settings rule (Adrienne's settings/locks/<name> refuses a locked one). Paste `rules` into the default instance, `family` into every family instance. 2026-10-29 🔒 ADRIENNE'S LOCKS PER CLASS (CPLOCKS, DESIGN_class_platform_2026-10-28.md §6.5, §13 row 15): classes/<cid>/locks/{brand,units,cards,tests,plan} = true (admin only, like the whole locks node) + locks/byName = the admin's display name (1–40 characters) the teacher reads in "🔒 set by …". While a part is locked the teacher's write is refused: brand → title, emoji, color (as before); cards → classCards/<cid> (and the old teacherCards/<cid>); tests → classTests/<cid>; plan → classes/<cid>/plan. units stays admin only. Adrienne's own writes are never refused. 2026-10-29 📆 SEND OUT EARLIER (CPSENDEARLY, DESIGN_class_platform_2026-10-28.md §8.3, §13 row 28): classes/<cid>/plan/<key>/sendOn = "YYYY-MM-DD", the planned send-out date (a plan, never a release; written under the plan rule, so the class's teacher, refused while locks/plan is on). When she ticks it, the same update also writes or rewrites a release/<cid>/scheduled/<id> record (validated by that rule as before).

specialistShare..validate: $part == 'study' && newData.isNumber() && newData.val() >= 50 && newData.val() <= 100 && (root.child('admins/'+auth.uid).val() == true || (root.child('classes/'+$cid+'/locks/specialists').val() != true && root.child('settings/locks/specialists').val() != true))

$sid..read: auth != null && ($sid.beginsWith(root.child('logins/'+auth.uid+'/familyId').val() + '_') || root.child('admins/'+auth.uid).val() == true || root.child('classes/'+data.child('class').val()+'/teacher').val() == auth.uid || (!data.exists() && root.child('classes/'+root.child('logins/'+auth.uid+'/cid').val()+'/teacher').val() == auth.uid))

meta..write: auth != null && ($sid.beginsWith(root.child('logins/'+auth.uid+'/familyId').val() + '_') || root.child('admins/'+auth.uid).val() == true || root.child('classes/'+root.child('students/'+$sid+'/class').val()+'/teacher').val() == auth.uid || root.child('classes/'+root.child('logins/'+auth.uid+'/cid').val()+'/teacher').val() == auth.uid)

review..validate: newData.hasChildren(['mode','by','role','at']) && (newData.child('mode').val() == 'sitting' || newData.child('mode').val() == 'parent') && newData.child('by').val() == auth.uid && newData.child('at').isNumber() && ((newData.child('role').val() == 'parent' && root.child('logins/'+auth.uid+'/role').val() == 'parent') || (newData.child('role').val() == 'teacher' && root.child('classes/'+root.child('students/'+$sid+'/class').val()+'/teacher').val() == auth.uid) || (newData.child('role').val() == 'admin' && root.child('admins/'+auth.uid).val() == true)) && (!newData.child('note').exists() || (newData.child('note').isString() && newData.child('note').val().length <= 200))

$sec..write: auth != null && (root.child('admins/'+auth.uid).val() == true || (root.child('classes/'+root.child('students/'+$sid+'/class').val()+'/teacher').val() == auth.uid && root.child('classes/'+root.child('students/'+$sid+'/class').val()+'/locks/sections').val() != true && root.child('settings/locks/sections').val() != true))

specialist..write: auth != null && (root.child('admins/'+auth.uid).val() == true || (root.child('classes/'+root.child('students/'+$sid+'/class').val()+'/teacher').val() == auth.uid && root.child('classes/'+root.child('students/'+$sid+'/class').val()+'/locks/specialists').val() != true && root.child('settings/locks/specialists').val() != true))

specialistShare..write: auth != null && (root.child('admins/'+auth.uid).val() == true || (root.child('classes/'+root.child('students/'+$sid+'/class').val()+'/teacher').val() == auth.uid && root.child('classes/'+root.child('students/'+$sid+'/class').val()+'/locks/specialists').val() != true && root.child('settings/locks/specialists').val() != true))

specialistNonCore..write: auth != null && (root.child('admins/'+auth.uid).val() == true || (root.child('classes/'+root.child('students/'+$sid+'/class').val()+'/teacher').val() == auth.uid && root.child('classes/'+root.child('students/'+$sid+'/class').val()+'/locks/specialists').val() != true && root.child('settings/locks/specialists').val() != true))

$name..write: auth != null && (root.child('admins/'+auth.uid).val() == true || (root.child('classes/'+root.child('students/'+$sid+'/class').val()+'/teacher').val() == auth.uid && root.child('settings/locks/'+$name).val() != true))

$key..validate: $key.matches(/^(general|general~k1|general~k2|general~k3|general~k4|general~k5|general~k6|general~k7|general~k8|forestry|forestry~k1|forestry~k2|forestry~k3|forestry~k4|soils|soils~k1|soils~k2|soils~k3|soils~k4|soils~k5|aquatics|aquatics~k1|aquatics~k2|aquatics~k3|aquatics~k4|wildlife|wildlife~k1|wildlife~k2|wildlife~k3|wildlife~k4|cei|cei~k1|cei~k2|cei~k3|cei~k4|cei~k5|General Concepts · Terms|General Concepts · Facts|Forestry · Terms|Forestry · Facts|Forestry · ID|Soils and Land Use · Terms|Soils and Land Use · Facts|Soils and Land Use · ID|Aquatic Ecology · Terms|Aquatic Ecology · Facts|Aquatic Ecology · ID|Wildlife · Terms|Wildlife · Facts|Wildlife · ID|Current Issue · 2027)$/) && newData.hasChildren(['openedAt','by']) && newData.child('openedAt').isNumber() && newData.child('by').val() == auth.uid && (!newData.child('level').exists() || newData.child('level').val() == 'section' || newData.child('level').val() == 'deck' || newData.child('level').val() == 'kc') && (!newData.child('sched').exists() || newData.child('sched').isString())

$key.matches(/^(general|general~k1|general~k2|general~k3|general~k4|general~k5|general~k6|general~k7|general~k8|forestry|forestry~k1|forestry~k2|forestry~k3|forestry~k4|soils|soils~k1|soils~k2|soils~k3|soils~k4|soils~k5|aquatics|aquatics~k1|aquatics~k2|aquatics~k3|aquatics~k4|wildlife|wildlife~k1|wildlife~k2|wildlife~k3|wildlife~k4|cei|cei~k1|cei~k2|cei~k3|cei~k4|cei~k5|General Concepts · Terms|General Concepts · Facts|Forestry · Terms|Forestry · Facts|Forestry · ID|Soils and Land Use · Terms|Soils and Land Use · Facts|Soils and Land Use · ID|Aquatic Ecology · Terms|Aquatic Ecology · Facts|Aquatic Ecology · ID|Wildlife · Terms|Wildlife · Facts|Wildlife · ID|Current Issue · 2027)$/) && newData.hasChildren(['openedAt','by']) && newData.child('openedAt').isNumber() && newData.child('by').val() == auth.uid && (!newData.child('level').exists() || newData.child('level').val() == 'section' || newData.child('level').val() == 'deck' || newData.child('level').val() == 'kc') && (!newData.child('sched').exists() || newData.child('sched').isString())

$schedId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['key','level','to','on','at','by','ts']) && newData.child('key').isString() && newData.child('key').val().matches(/^(general|general~k1|general~k2|general~k3|general~k4|general~k5|general~k6|general~k7|general~k8|forestry|forestry~k1|forestry~k2|forestry~k3|forestry~k4|soils|soils~k1|soils~k2|soils~k3|soils~k4|soils~k5|aquatics|aquatics~k1|aquatics~k2|aquatics~k3|aquatics~k4|wildlife|wildlife~k1|wildlife~k2|wildlife~k3|wildlife~k4|cei|cei~k1|cei~k2|cei~k3|cei~k4|cei~k5|General Concepts · Terms|General Concepts · Facts|Forestry · Terms|Forestry · Facts|Forestry · ID|Soils and Land Use · Terms|Soils and Land Use · Facts|Soils and Land Use · ID|Aquatic Ecology · Terms|Aquatic Ecology · Facts|Aquatic Ecology · ID|Wildlife · Terms|Wildlife · Facts|Wildlife · ID|Current Issue · 2027)$/) && (newData.child('level').val() == 'section' || newData.child('level').val() == 'deck' || newData.child('level').val() == 'kc') && newData.child('on').isString() && newData.child('on').val().matches(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/) && newData.child('at').isString() && newData.child('at').val().matches(/^[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$/) && (newData.child('to').val() == 'all' || newData.child('to').hasChildren()) && newData.child('by').val() == auth.uid && newData.child('ts').isNumber()

$card..write: auth != null && (root.child('admins/'+auth.uid).val() == true || (root.child('classes/'+$cid+'/teacher').val() == auth.uid && root.child('classes/'+$cid+'/locks/cards').val() != true && (!data.exists() || data.child('by').val() == auth.uid)))
auth != null && ((root.child('classes/'+$cid+'/teacher').val() == auth.uid && root.child('classes/'+$cid+'/locks/cards').val() != true) || root.child('admins/'+auth.uid).val() == true)
$card..validate: newData.hasChildren(['name','by','ts']) && newData.child('by').val() == auth.uid && (newData.child('hide').val() == true || newData.child('def').exists() || newData.child('add').val() == true) && (newData.child('add').val() != true || (newData.child('def').exists() && newData.child('core').isBoolean() && !newData.child('name').val().matches(/[.#$\[\]\/]/)))

$form..write: auth != null && ((root.child('classes/'+$cid+'/teacher').val() == auth.uid && root.child('classes/'+$cid+'/locks/tests').val() != true) || root.child('admins/'+auth.uid).val() == true)

$item..validate: $item.matches(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}$/) && newData.hasChildren(['by','ts']) && newData.child('by').val() == auth.uid && (newData.child('hide').val() == true || newData.child('q').exists()) && (newData.child('add').val() != true || newData.child('q').exists()) && (!newData.child('q').exists() || (newData.hasChildren(['choices','ans']) && newData.child('choices/1').exists() && !newData.child('choices/5').exists()))

ans..validate: (newData.isNumber() && (newData.val() == 0 || newData.val() == 1 || (newData.val() == 2 && newData.parent().child('choices/2').exists()) || (newData.val() == 3 && newData.parent().child('choices/3').exists()) || (newData.val() == 4 && newData.parent().child('choices/4').exists()))) || (newData.hasChild('0') && (!newData.hasChild('1') || (newData.hasChild('0') && newData.child('1').val() > newData.child('0').val())) && (!newData.hasChild('2') || (newData.hasChild('1') && newData.child('2').val() > newData.child('1').val())) && (!newData.hasChild('3') || (newData.hasChild('2') && newData.child('3').val() > newData.child('2').val())) && (!newData.hasChild('4') || (newData.hasChild('3') && newData.child('4').val() > newData.child('3').val())))

$key..write: auth != null && ((!data.exists() && (root.child('classes/'+$cid+'/teacher').val() == auth.uid || root.child('admins/'+auth.uid).val() == true) && root.child('students/'+$sid+'/class').val() == $cid) || (root.child('admins/'+auth.uid).val() == true && !newData.exists()))

family._about: Paste into EVERY family instance (<projectId>-<familyId>). Only that family's two logins (seeded under allowed/) read or write their own instance; the teacher and the console never touch it.
